boundedFindings.result: Early fence clears Bridge admission/focus, quiesces mailbox, revokes local-resource admission and invalidates execution context before native close can resume a paused script. Updated entry/message/recovery gates retain this fence. Original cleanup lane owns input cancellation/unregister and retains mailbox until completion.

accept_drain validates identity/counts and never promotes native Pending to retired. Physical release requires actual PayloadRetired and empty operations/callbacks/payload. terminal_result retains failure_code after physical release, and facade close/destroy returns that same origin failure.

Normal async receipts settle exactly once; active completion holds state; unmount closes target before waiting pending native callbacks, then retains COM refs until callbacks return. unmount/Close reentry stays busy, current_source pins target and checks generation after COM, output ready publication rechecks phase/generation/document/stop after Post. serialize_output contains invocationId.

Public configuration access defaults disabled; templates retain allow_native_devtools=false; CMake package option remains OFF with explicit pins. Packaging selects materials without granting runtime authority; managedFiles includes new redistribution document.
